SETUP-1.name: NOT_REVIEWED
SETUP-1.description: Raised when apply is asked for before the answers have been reviewed.

SETUP-16.name: GUARD_UNANSWERED
SETUP-16.description: Raised when a VPN answer leaves the egress guard without what it needs to start.

SETUP-5.name: DOES_NOT_APPLY
SETUP-5.description: Raised when an answer is not meaningful on the platform setup is running on.

SETUP-7.name: ALREADY_SET_UP
SETUP-7.description: Raised when setup is answered on a machine that is already set up.

SETUP-8.name: NOTHING_TO_RECOVER
SETUP-8.description: Raised when a recovery is asked for and no apply stopped part-way.
